summary: Group owner assignments now end after at most 180 days, in line with Microsoft's guidance.

fixes.title: No standing group owners
fixes.text: The standard PIM for Groups policy now ends active owner assignments after at most 180 days. Owners PIM Manager keeps on its own groups are not affected.

fixes.title: Times shown in your local time
fixes.text: Update times were shown in UTC without saying so. They now use your browser's local time.
